desc: Implement the finite-state DP: for each modulus 1..9, maintain counts of all non-empty substrings ending at the previous index by remainder, append the next digit using a fresh state, add its one-digit substring, and query remainder 0 only when the current digit is non-zero.
Validate against samples and a brute-force quadratic oracle, including zeros, leading zeros, repeated 4/8/7, and alternating 1/0 strings.
Produce final `Solution.countSubstrings` code and state time/space complexity.
